public_rationale: The research provides concrete examples of usefulness and limitations. limitations: The existence of useful assistance is easier to test than the claimed extent of overstatement.

our_interpretation: Current systems means the next-token-prediction systems discussed in the surrounding paragraph.
I assess October 1–18, 2023, the current calendar month through publication.
The ordinary reading combines an existence claim about useful applications with a substantial overstatement claim about common contemporary descriptions of their usefulness.

Testing the second part requires an identifiable, reasonably representative collection of contemporary application claims. I do not invent a count or treat every proposed application as a claim of proven reliability.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes useful applications and shows that a representative set of contemporary claims substantially exceeds the applications reliably usable in practice.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A representative comparison shows that contemporary claims generally matched demonstrated practical reliability, or evidence disproves the existence of any practically useful applications.
